scope: Reviewed Rust interpretation and drift guard; hashes are not a proof of Rust execution or cryptographic soundness. Lean checks the window-parametric relations reconstructed from the retained artifacts.

prover/src/gkr/prover/forward_loop/mod.r.observation: Selects the supplied per-set top bits using the artifact set indices.

prover/src/gkr/prover/forward_loop/utils.observation: Adds the public high bits shifted by the geometry-derived offset to each flattened RAM factor.

prover/src/gkr/prover/mod.rs.observation: Connects the actual materialized row-address virtual columns to GKR base storage.

prover/src/gkr/virtual_polys/init_and_te.observation: Materializes row-only virtual low/high address columns, without adding public windows.
